title: Conte de Noel
identity: Robert Planel's Suite Romantique no. 5, Conte de Noël, is an alto saxophone and piano piece, Leduc AL20250.

evidence.claim: An opened library catalog identifies the six-part Suite romantique for alto saxophone and piano, published by Leduc in 1944.
The retailer search result identifies no. 5 as Conte de Noel for alto saxophone and piano.

The Philharmonie de Paris ten-year saxophone guide lists no. 5, Conte de Noël, as moderate and calm in 6/8, with three sharps; listed duration 3:20. This is a guide description, not direct score inspection.
evidence.source_name: Philharmonie de Paris, Dix ans avec le saxophone

review_focus: The guide reports a moderate, calm 6/8 character. Inspect the score for phrasing and rhythmic execution; no notation was inspected.
collection_flag: One of Planel's original six saxophone/piano pieces; intended level is unresolved.
gaps: No score or actual saxophone recording inspected.
